newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks end higher amid retail buying.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks end higher amid retail buying.

text.p: Dhaka stocks ended higher amid buying by small investors as the market recovered for the second day, brokers said.
Brokers said scrips in engineering, pharmaceutical and cement sectors attracted retail buying after they reached their lowest in a recent bearish spell.
"We expect a continued upward trend as the price reached the bottom level," said broker Moshtaque Ahmed. He said most of the scrips were attractive to the investors as they became now "under-priced."
The Dhaka Stock Exchange all-share price index gained 13.09 points or 1.19 percent at 1,110.46 on a turnover of 56.5 million taka. Gainers led losers by 99 to 31.
Delta Life Insurance rallied for a second day after the company announced higher premium earnings for 1996 and offered 26 taka dividend on its 100 taka share for the year against 12 taka previously.
Bangladesh Lamps was the leader in engineering sector that gained 68.31 taka to 4,950.81 followed by Singer Bangladesh which rose 66.89 to 5,933.7.
Beximco Pharmaceuticals was the volume leader with 34,000 shares traded. The share gained 3.58 to 141.54.
